scope: Source corpus, graph construction, coordinate projection and graph node labels; no training run

findings.issue: Local range/synthetic coordinate semantics differ from author endpoint layout
findings.resolution: New independent label-derived endpoint adapter; old graph fields and features unchanged

findings.issue: Old builder merges by basename without category checks and silently skips invalid CSV/missing graphs or sources
findings.resolution: New path/category/source provenance, required annotation coverage and fail-closed numeric/source checks

findings.issue: Positive contracts must not be inferred from node positives
findings.example: Author parity_wallet_bug_2.sol contract target=1 but zero saved positive nodes
findings.resolution: Preserve independent contract manifest and select line graph by that manifest

findings.issue: Graph call resolution and relation taxonomy are not yet fully equivalent to paper/author assets
findings.resolution: Reported, not changed in isolated labeling experiment

findings.issue: Existing author audit omits zero-positive files and conflates reconstruction with independent provenance
findings.resolution: All files selected via contract manifest; public labels computed before reading author reference

findings.issue: Original SolidiFI CSV has overlap/suspect length boundaries and extra unnamed column
findings.resolution: Retain public benchmark coordinates with explicit audit flags; no semantic correction without evidence

findings.issue: Author reference contains out-of-bounds records and a foreign-category reentrancy annotation; historical SmartBugs snapshot differs
findings.resolution: Keep as comparator only; do not copy into independent labels
